MediaCritic est le podcast francophone q: MediaCritic is a French-language podcast that dissects podcasts, shows and YouTube channels with the same rigour you'd bring to a film or a TV series.
Chaque épisode examine un format audio o: Each episode examines an audio or video format as a whole: form, substance and intentions. What makes a good show strong? Where are its limits? What does it tell us about our relationship with sound and storytelling?
Animé en alternance par Alex et Lolo, av: Hosted in turn by Alex and Lolo, with regular guests such as Gaëlle or Steph — each episode offers a fresh, personal and rigorous take.

The podcast that gives its opinion even when nobody asked — the French-language Metacritic of podcasts, minus the condescension and with far more humour.

Alex a écouté tellement de podcasts qu'i: Alex has listened to so many podcasts that he now analyses bar-room conversations in terms of "substance, form and intentions". His family stopped asking him "did you like it?" after a film — the answer lasts 25 minutes, ends with a score out of 10, and always includes a comparison with a podcast episode. At MediaCritic, he handles episode writing, social media and tech, which explains a lot about the poor quality of the whole thing — but just like with his hair, he's made his peace with it and keeps going.
Lolo est le genre de personne qui commen: Lolo is the kind of person who starts a sentence with "to keep it short" and ends it 8 minutes later with an analogy about the French school system. He has answered "it depends" to every question asked since 2009 — and he was right every time, which is both admirable and very hard to live with day to day. Officially co-host, sound engineer, creative, butcher, woodcutter — he's the show's comfort blanket, its voice of wisdom, calm and serenity.
Une idée de podcast à analyser, une coll: An idea for a podcast to review, a collaboration, a message of encouragement or constructive insult — you can reach us.
